title: Garlic Chicken Pasta
description: Quick weeknight pasta with seared chicken and a garlicky pan sauce.
instructions: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Season the chicken and sear in a hot pan until cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds, then toss in pasta, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
